hook.description: The opening line 'Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?' is a quick, sharp start with a sly barb in E4. The clip closes on Rupert's reveal that 'the title is mine' in E16, which gives a strong ending beat.

cliffhanger.description: Rupert's claim that the title will be his once Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown is left pending at the cut, so the stakes stay open. The clip ends before any sealing or outcome is shown.

promos.why_it_works: A sharp sugar-and-sweetness rivalry escalates into Rupert's chilling claim on the title, and the unfinished Crown sealing leaves the threat hanging at the cut.
